properties.name: state-machine.persistence.schema.mode
properties.description: How the starter treats library tables at startup: create missing tables, validate an existing schema, or leave DDL to Flyway/Liquibase.

values.description: Create missing tables from state-machine-schema.sql. Use in demo and tests.
Fail fast if tables, columns, keys or the recovery index do not match. Recommended in production when the starter owns schema checks.
Do not touch schema. Use when Flyway or Liquibase applies docs/state-machine-schema.sql.
